item.title: Envoy urges Iran, Iraq to shift scientific ties from student recruitment to joint projects
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iraqi ambassador to Iran has said cooperation between the two countries in the scientific field must not rest solely on recruiting students, it should instead advance toward joint project implementation, the exchange of professors and researchers, and the growth of technological collaboration.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86298245/Envoy-urges-Iran-Iraq-to-shift-scientific-ties-from-student

Tehran, IRNA – Iraqi ambassador to Iran has said cooperation between the two countries in the scientific field must not rest solely on recruiting students, it should instead advance toward joint project implementation, the exchange of professors and researchers, and the growth of technological collaboration.

item.title: US warmongering disrupts global food security: Agriculture minister
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s agriculture minister has warned that US unilateralism and warmongering are disrupting global food security and the transportation of food and agricultural products, calling on international organizations to ensure everyone’s right to access food.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86298263/US-warmongering-disrupts-global-food-security-Agriculture-minister

Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s agriculture minister has warned that US unilateralism and warmongering are disrupting global food security and the transportation of food and agricultural products, calling on international organizations to ensure everyone’s right to access food.

item.title: Trump’s new threat will not break Iranian nation’s resolve: Ambassador

item.title: Putin, Pezeshkian to continue consultations at Moscow gas summit: Iranian envoy
item.description: Moscow, IRNA — Iranian ambassador to Russia says consultations between President Masoud Pezeshkian and his Russian counterpart, Vladimir Putin, will continue on the sidelines of the upcoming summit of the Gas Exporting Countries Forum (GECF) in Moscow, as Tehran and Moscow intensify high-level diplomatic engagement.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86297831/Putin-Pezeshkian-to-continue-consultations-at-Moscow-gas-summit

Moscow, IRNA — Iranian ambassador to Russia says consultations between President Masoud Pezeshkian and his Russian counterpart, Vladimir Putin, will continue on the sidelines of the upcoming summit of the Gas Exporting Countries Forum (GECF) in Moscow, as Tehran and Moscow intensify high-level diplomatic engagement.
